title: Fluent Builder Pattern
overview: A Builder variant where each setter returns the builder itself, enabling method chaining for readable object construction.
useCases: Same as Builder but where method chaining improves readability
When build steps can be expressed as a readable chain of calls
When optional parameters are common and you want to avoid telescoping constructors
exampleUses: Setting up test fixtures with many optional fields where only a few change per test case
Constructing API client configuration where each option (timeout, retries, base URL) is set independently
